description: Use when an agent needs what a Base address holds in one call instead of one RPC call per token. Input: address; optional tokens (up to 20 ERC-20 addresses, comma-separated; default USDC, EURC, USDbC, WETH, cbBTC, cbETH, wstETH). Output: JSON block+time, ETH balance, per-token symbol, decimals, raw and decimal balance, nonce, isContract. Chain state only, no prices. Bad input: 400, not charged. Example: ?address=0x6246eee0355Dd7A93C888fE59e1151388A0cC5a1 Price: $0.002 USDC via x402.

address.description: Wallet or contract on Base mainnet (0x + 40 hex; mixed case must be a valid EIP-55 checksum). Bad input → 400 (not charged)

tokens.description: Up to 20 comma-separated ERC-20 contract addresses on Base. Omit for the default set. A contract that is not an ERC-20 is listed with status not_an_erc20.

name: base_wallet_balances
title: Base wallet balances: ETH + many ERC-20s in one call, with nonce and contract flag
